title: Participatory Evaluation (of) Aging (With) Rapamycin (for) Longevity Study
primary_endpoint: Change in visceral fat (DXA); also blood, skeletal-muscle, lean-tissue, quality-of-life measures
endpoint_note: Body-composition + self-reported QoL surrogates; NOT mortality/healthspan hard endpoints. Largest published off-label rapamycin longevity RCT to date; reported safety + some lean-mass/QoL signal in women.

title: Combination Gerotherapeutic Interventions for Healthspan Improvement
intervention_class: combination geroprotector (rapamycin + metformin + NAD+ + naltrexone + GSH)
primary_endpoint: Change in VO2 max (cardiorespiratory fitness); cognitive composite (Creyos); systemic inflammation (iAge index)
endpoint_note: VO2max + cognition + inflammatory clock are functional/biomarker surrogates. Labeled Phase 3 but tiny (n=30) — a combination-stack proof-of-concept, not a registrational outcome trial.

title: MTOR Inhibitors in Older Adults
sponsor: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center
primary_endpoint: Pharmacokinetics (Cmax, Ctrough) of sirolimus/everolimus in older adults
endpoint_note: Pure PK/dose-finding — establishes geroprotective dosing windows; no efficacy endpoint.

title: Targeting Aging with Metformin
sponsor: American Federation for Aging Research (AFAR) / Nir Barzilai (Albert Einstein)
primary_endpoint: Composite time-to-first-event of a major age-related disease (cardiovascular, cancer, dementia) or death
endpoint_note: The field's flagship attempt at a HARD composite morbidity/mortality endpoint and an FDA 'aging-as-indication' precedent. As of 2026 NOT fully funded and NOT actively enrolling under a public NCT — included as a tracked design, not an active study. (ClinicalTrials.gov metformin-aging search surfaces CALERIE-Legacy, not TAME.)

title: The CALERIE Legacy Study
interventions: (observational legacy follow-up of prior 2-yr 25% CR RCT)
population: Former CALERIE-2 participants (CR vs ad-libitum), now age 33+
endpoint_note: Biological-age clock + healthspan composites — surrogate, but the longest-running human CR cohort. Parent CALERIE-2 RCT showed CR slowed DunedinPACE pace-of-aging (Waziry 2023).

title: Effects of MIB-626 (NAD precursor) With and Without High-Intensity Exercise
primary_endpoint: Change in VO2 max (aerobic capacity) at week 11
endpoint_note: VO2max functional surrogate. Tests whether NAD+ repletion augments exercise adaptation. Feeds the open NAD+-precursor-efficacy conflict (surrogate raised, outcome unproven).

title: Senolytic Therapy to Modulate Progression of Alzheimer's Disease
primary_endpoint: CNS penetrance of dasatinib & quercetin (CSF); safety/tolerability/feasibility
endpoint_note: Pilot (n=5) — feasibility + drug brain-penetrance, NOT cognition/disease outcome. First-in-human CNS senolytic.

title: Open-Label Trial to Reduce Senescence and Improve Frailty in Adult Survivors of Childhood Cancer
population: Adult survivors of childhood cancer with frailty, age 18+
endpoint_note: Gait speed is a validated function/mortality-correlated surrogate but not a hard endpoint. Tests senolytics in an accelerated-aging human model.

title: Alleviation by Fisetin of Frailty, Inflammation, and Related Measures in Older Adults
endpoint_note: Inflammatory biomarker surrogate. Part of the Mayo (Kirkland/LeBrasseur) senolytic program — the lineage that coined 'senolytics'.

title: Fisetin to Improve Vascular Function in Older Adults
population: Older adults age 65+ with endothelial dysfunction/arterial stiffness
sponsor: University of Colorado, Boulder (Seals lab lineage)
primary_endpoint: Change in endothelial function (flow-mediated dilation) at 1 month
endpoint_note: Vascular-function surrogate. Tests whether senolytic fisetin improves a mechanistic cardiovascular-aging marker.

title: Taurine as a Possible Anti-aging Therapy?
primary_endpoint: Change in blood oxidative-stress markers (SOD, glutathione reductase, MDA)
endpoint_note: Small (n=24) oxidative-stress biomarker pilot. Follows Singh et al. 2023 Science (taurine deficiency as a driver of aging in mice/monkeys) — animal-tier origin, human surrogate test.

title: Effects of Therapeutic Plasma Exchange (TPE) on Age-Related Biomarkers and Epigenetics
primary_endpoint: TPE safety (adverse events); rate of change in blood epigenetic clock
endpoint_note: Epigenetic-clock surrogate + safety. Tests the Conboy 'blood dilution' rejuvenation hypothesis. Small n=40 despite Phase 3 label.

title: Plasma Exchange With 5% Albumin in Beta-amyloid Clearance (Alzheimer's)
endpoint_note: Amyloid biomarker surrogate; precursor to the AMBAR plasma-exchange Alzheimer's program. Included as the disease-specific analogue of systemic plasma-exchange 'rejuvenation'.

title: Reversing Muscle Loss With Exercise + Pomegranate (Urolithin A precursor)
population: Adults age 50+ with sarcopenia / CV risk
primary_endpoint: Change in muscle volume; sarcopenic obesity; aerobic capacity
endpoint_note: Body-composition + fitness surrogates. Mitophagy/mitochondrial-quality thesis (urolithin A).

title: Effects of Mitopure (Urolithin A) on Skeletal Muscle Function & Endurance
primary_endpoint: Change in plasma creatine kinase; 3000 m race performance time
endpoint_note: Performance + muscle-damage surrogates. Industry-sponsored (Amazentis sells Mitopure) — COI flag. Mitophagy biology has human muscle-RCT support but no longevity outcome.
